sloka: वर्षघ्नमेकं श्वभ्रं तु हिमघ्नमपरं तथा ।ग्रीष्मघ्नं तु सुखस्पर्शमेकं कुर्वन्तु शिल्पिनः ।। ७.५४.९ ॥
transliteration: varṣaghnamekaṁ śvabhraṁ tu himaghnamaparaṁ tathā ।grīṣmaghnaṁ tu sukhasparśamekaṁ kurvantu śilpinaḥ ।। 7.54.9 ॥

translations.english: The artisans should construct one cave that is rain-proof, another that is cold-proof, and a third, pleasant to touch, that is summer-proof.
